configuration.shape: 1 1/8-mile main oval with inner and outer turf courses
configuration.note: Wide galloping oval. Speed figures carry the read rather than early position; turf routes on the inner course are the exception where post and pace shape matter more.

engine.weight_note: Engine runs at roughly two-thirds designed weight with Top Ratings unsourced. Maiden races carry four further blanks (the four Win % columns) because Equibase omits them when every runner is winless.

data_pull.note: Races 5 and 8 returned no speed figures from Entries Plus. Handled under the field-wide judgment protocol using pedigree, connections, market support and equipment from the Equibase entry pages. Graded separately from figure-based races.

selections.case: Field-best 102 figure at the distance and at this track, 16 starts at a mile with 5 wins, 31% at the distance. Deepest distance record in the race by a distance.
selections.reservation: Jockey/trainer combo 0%, and he runs back in 11 days.

selections.case: Highest average figure at 84 and a 99 best, plus the field's top early pace figure at 90.
selections.reservation: 278 days off and only 3 lifetime starts. The layoff is the whole risk and the market is not paying you for it.

selections.case: 93 best figure at this track, won last out, 33% at the track.
selections.reservation: Only 11 starts and 22% jockey/trainer; his figures sit a full class below the top two.

alternate.reason: 92 best figure at the track, 40% win at the track over 5 starts, ran 2nd last out.
alternate.left_off_because: 47 best figure at the distance is the worst in the field and he is 0-for-1 going a mile.

fades.case_for: 12 starts at the distance with 2 wins and a 39-start body of work — most experience in the race.
fades.why_still_off: 68 average figure is the lowest of any horse with a full record, and 0% at this track across 5 starts.

races.summary: Tough Street owns the distance and track figures; Nuanced owns the raw speed but is returning from nine months off. Taking both rather than choosing between an unproven layoff horse and a proven grinder.

selections.case: Best jockey/trainer combo in the race at 28% and the most earnings per start among the raced horses.
selections.reservation: 53 average figure is modest and his early pace figure of 19 is the worst in the field — he will be last early.

selections.case: Has a start at the distance and a 69 early pace figure, second-best among horses with data.
selections.reservation: 54 figure, 0% jockey/trainer, and finished 7th in his only start.

selections.case: First-time starter with a 24% jockey/trainer combo, second-strongest connection stat in the race.
selections.reservation: No data of any kind. This is a market-and-connections inclusion, not a figure-based one.

alternate.reason: 67 best figure is the highest of any raced horse in the field.
alternate.left_off_because: 33 early pace figure and an 8% jockey/trainer combo; finished 7th in his only start.

fades.case_for: Three starts, the most experience in the race, and a 79 early pace figure that is best in the field.
fades.why_still_off: 41 average figure is near the bottom and he runs back in 7 days off a 6th.

races.summary: Turf sprint maiden with five first-time starters and no horse showing a figure above 67. Nobody here has demonstrated anything. Spread and expect chaos.

selections.case: 75% at this track over 12 starts with 3 wins, 43% at the distance, won last out, 83 average figure second-best in the race.
selections.reservation: 92 best figure is a notch below the top pair; 41 days off.

selections.case: Highest average figure at 84, 99 best, and a 90 early pace figure that is 11 clear of the field.
selections.reservation: 278-day layoff off just 3 career starts, and no starts at this track.

selections.case: 95 best figure at this track, 33% at the distance, ran 2nd last out.
selections.reservation: 0% at the track across 5 starts despite the 95 — the figure and the record disagree.

alternate.reason: 93 figure at the track, won last out, 25% at the distance.
alternate.left_off_because: Only 4 starts on the surface and a 75 average figure.

fades.case_for: 50% win rate at the distance and won last out at this track.
fades.why_still_off: 6% jockey/trainer combo, lowest in the race, and a 74 average figure.

races.summary: Get a Job has the track record, Nuanced has the speed. Same layoff caveat as race 1 applies to Nuanced, who is entered in both.

selections.case: 70 best figure is the highest in the field and $18,000 earnings per start is nearly double anyone else. Ran 2nd last out.
selections.reservation: 31 early pace figure means she needs the race to come back to her, and she has never gone this far.

selections.case: 68 figure, second-best, with a 22% jockey/trainer combo and a 3rd last out.
selections.reservation: One career start and no experience at the distance.

selections.case: 81 early pace figure ranks second and she has two turf starts, most in the field.
selections.reservation: 73 best figure but a 6th last out; two starts and no win.

alternate.reason: Field-best 85 early pace figure and two turf starts.

fades.case_for: 66 figure and $10,800 earnings per start, third-best in the race, with a 3rd last out.
fades.why_still_off: No turf start at all and only 15% connections.

races.scratch_risk_note: Sixteen entered on turf. Rain or a course change would gut this field and likely force also-eligibles in.
races.summary: Sixteen-horse turf maiden with four first-time starters and no runner showing a figure above 70. Nobody has run a route on grass. Spread wide or pass.

selections.case: Pletcher and Carmouche for Eclipse Thoroughbred Partners. Drain the Clock over a Malibu Moon mare is the most sprint-precocious pedigree in the field and an ideal fit for six furlongs first time out.
selections.reservation: First-time starter with nothing proven. This is pedigree and barn projection, not evidence.

selections.case: Chad Brown, Flavien Prat, Don Alberto as owner and breeder, second start off a debut. Brown saddles two and Prat chose this one.
selections.reservation: Finished 8th on debut, and Tacitus is a Tapit-line route sire — she may want much more ground than 6f.

selections.case: George Weaver and Manny Franco at a 22% combination, by Upstart out of an Include mare.
selections.reservation: First-time starter, and the pedigree reads versatile rather than sprint-specific.

alternate.reason: Chad Brown's other runner with Santana up for Michael Dubb and Elkstone — top-tier NY connections on a debut.
alternate.left_off_because: Prat chose the stablemate, which is the barn's own signal about which is preferred.

fades.case_for: Highest jockey/trainer figure in the race at 25%, by Volatile — a genuine sprint sire — and she already has a race under her in a field of six first-timers.
fades.why_still_off: Her Equibase last-start value returned unreadable and I will not guess at what she ran.

races.summary: No speed figures exist for this field — six of nine have never started. Selected under the field-wide judgment protocol on pedigree fit for a 2yo filly sprint, barn and rider strength, and market support. A $150,000 maiden claiming tag means this is allowance-quality stock despite the category. Graded separately from the figure-based races on this card.

selections.case: Field-best 86 average figure, field-best 89 early pace, 67% at the distance with 2 wins from 3, and 100% at this track.
selections.reservation: 327 days off — nearly eleven months — and a 7th in her last start.

selections.case: 80 average figure second-best, 38% win rate, 43% on turf, and $23,531 per start.
selections.reservation: 0% at the distance across 4 starts — she has not won going this far.

selections.case: 95 best figure is the highest in the race, won last out, 100% at this track, 29% at the distance.
selections.reservation: 0% jockey/trainer combo and only 6 turf starts from 21 lifetime.

alternate.reason: 50% at the distance and a 29% jockey/trainer combo, running back in 11 days.
alternate.left_off_because: Only one turf start with a 0% strike rate on the surface — a dirt horse switching.

fades.case_for: Favourite on the morning line with $213,740 earned and a 24% jockey/trainer combo.
fades.why_still_off: One lifetime turf start, 0% on the surface, 0% at the distance, and a 9th last out. The price and the record do not match.

races.summary: Annascaul is best on figures, pace and track record but has been away almost a year. Silsbee is the safer body. Actively against the 9/5 favourite, who has one turf start and finished 9th last time.

selections.case: Only horse in the field with a start at this distance, and she won it. 33% win rate, 50% at the track, $23,867 per start — highest in the race.
selections.reservation: Three lifetime starts. The 100% at the distance is a single race and I am not treating it as a rate.

selections.case: 78 average figure is the field's best, with an 86 top figure and a 2nd last out.
selections.reservation: 0-for-8 lifetime. Eight starts, no wins — your Step 9 warning in plain form.

selections.case: 93 best figure is highest in the race, 20 starts of seasoning, 3 wins, 7 starts at this track.
selections.reservation: 75 average against a 93 peak, and 14% at the track.

alternate.reason: Won last out, 86 figure, 50% on turf and a 24% jockey/trainer combo.
alternate.left_off_because: 46 early pace figure is near the bottom and only 2 turf starts.

fades.case_for: 84 early pace figure is the field's best and she is a co-second choice on the line.
fades.why_still_off: No win in 6 starts and no experience at a mile and an eighth.

races.summary: Nobody in here has run a mile and an eighth except Silly Season, and almost nobody wins — the field's win rates are dominated by 0-for-4 through 0-for-8 records. Distance is the separator because the figures are not.

selections.case: Only runner in the field who has finished in the money — 2nd last out — back in 34 days with Velazquez for Dutrow. The one real form line in the race.
selections.reservation: 8% jockey/trainer combination, and he is the only horse running without Lasix while six rivals get it first time.

selections.case: Chad Brown and Prat at a 24% combination. Nyquist out of an Into Mischief mare is the strongest pedigree in the race for this trip.
selections.reservation: First-time starter at six and a half furlongs, a demanding debut distance.

selections.case: Four starts with a 3rd last out and a sharp 21-day turnaround. City of Light over an Orb mare.
selections.reservation: 0% jockey/trainer combination and four starts without winning.

alternate.reason: Five starts, the most experienced runner in the race, with Carmouche up and already on Lasix.
alternate.left_off_because: 0-for-5 with a 0% jockey/trainer figure — a maiden after five tries with cold connections.

fades.case_for: Pletcher and Castellano for Eclipse and Bridlewood is as strong a debut package as exists.
fades.why_still_off: 0% jockey/trainer figure and Beau Liam is an obscure sire with nothing to project from.

races.summary: No speed figures returned for any runner. Three horses have form lines, which makes this the better of the two judgment races. Equipment is the live angle — six get first-time Lasix and Bogus Operandi runs on none. Graded separately from the figure-based races.

selections.case: 113 best figure, 100 average, 57% at the distance over 7 starts with 4 wins, 44% on turf, 100% at this track, ran 2nd last out on 26 days rest. The most complete profile in the race and every percentage rests on a real sample.
selections.reservation: The 100% at the track is only 2 starts; his case is the 113 and the distance record, not that number.

selections.case: Field-best 115 figure and a 102 average, highest in the race. 43% at the distance, 96 early pace figure leads the field.
selections.reservation: 299 days off — nearly ten months — and 0% jockey/trainer combo.

selections.case: 114 figure, 99 average, $1,594,316 earned — nearly double anyone here — with 14 starts at the distance.
selections.reservation: 5th last out and 0% at this track; 34 starts means the mileage is real.

alternate.reason: Won last out, 44% win rate, 50% on turf, 67% at this track, and $49,207 per start is the highest in the race.
alternate.left_off_because: 92 average figure trails the top three by seven or more and he has one start at the distance, 0-for-1.

fades.case_for: Even-money favourite, 8 wins from 27, $621,959 earned, 24% jockey/trainer, 7 starts at the distance.
fades.why_still_off: Only 7 turf starts from 27 lifetime and a 14% strike rate on the surface, with an 89 average figure that is the lowest of any principal. At even money there is no margin for that.

races.summary: The best and deepest-data race on the card. Running Bee separates on figures, distance record and track form simultaneously, and the samples behind his percentages are genuine rather than two-start artifacts. Against the even-money favourite, whose turf record does not support the price.

selections.case: 83 best figure leads the field, 82 at the distance, 10 turf starts and 4 at the trip — most experience of anyone.
selections.reservation: 0-for-10 lifetime with a 9th last out and a 0% jockey/trainer combo. A maiden after ten tries is a maiden for a reason.

selections.case: 72 figure, ran 2nd last out, 11% connections and only 3 starts — least exposed of the horses with form.
selections.reservation: Modest 55 early pace and no win in 3.

selections.case: 76 figure with 4 starts at the distance and 5 on turf.
selections.reservation: 0-for-7 and a 4th last out; 0% jockey/trainer.

alternate.reason: 72 figure and the field's best jockey/trainer combo at 33%, with 3 starts at the distance.

fades.case_for: First-time starter with a 22% jockey/trainer combo and solid market support.
fades.why_still_off: No data of any kind, in a 16-horse turf route. That is absence of evidence, not concealed form, and the field is too large to guess into.

races.scratch_risk_note: Sixteen on turf at the end of the card. Weather or a course switch would reshape it entirely.
races.summary: Sixteen-horse maiden claimer full of horses who have failed repeatedly. No selection here has ever won a race. Lowest-conviction leg on the card after the two no-plays.

tickets.note: 3 x 3 x 1 x 3 = 27 combinations at 50 cents. Race 9 singled on Running Bee; races 5 and 8 are no-plays so the sequence skips them.
3 x 1 x 3 = 9 combinations at $1. Race 9 singled on Running Bee.
